visualInspection.assessment: Theme contrast, Bungee headings, everyday typography, spacing, chat surfaces, status labels and mobile layout were inspected; no clipping or page overflow was observed.

limitations: Only isolated mock realtime was exercised. No server authentication, room authorization, persistence, real recipient key exchange or real-user delivery was connected.
Existing group previews accept simulated group-compatible events; no group creation/invitation/membership contract was fabricated.
Socket adapter rejection, malformed/stale/duplicate event handling and real-send encryption gating require focused unit coverage; no live server behavior is claimed.
